title.en: An Act Further to Amend Act Numbered Eighteen Hundred and Seventy, By Authorizing the Board of Regents of the University of the Philippines to Receive in Trust Legacies, Gifts, and Donations of Real and Personal Property of Any Kind.

text.en:
Section six of Act Numbered Eighteen hundred and seventy, as amended by Act Numbered Two
thousand and twenty-four, is hereby further amended by adding thereto the following subsection:
" (i) To receive in trust legacies, gifts, and donations of real and personal property of all kinds and to
administer the same for the benefit of the University, or of a department thereof, or for aid to any student or
students, in accordance with the direction or instructions of the donor, and, in default thereof, in such manner
as the Board of Regents may in its discretion determine."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 5, 1915.
